newsitem.title: USA: Wal-Mart Jan same-store sales up 6.6 pct.
newsitem.headline: Wal-Mart Jan same-store sales up 6.6 pct.

text.p: Wal-Mart Stores Inc said Thursday net sales for the four weeks ended January 31 rose 14.9 percent, to $7.02 billion from $6.11 billion a year ago, while same-store sales rose 6.6 percent.
For the 52 weeks ended January 31, sales rose 11.7 percent to $104.4 billion.
Sam's Clubs sales for the four-week period were $1.39 billion, up 7.7 percent from $1.29 billion a year ago. Sales for the 52 weeks were $19.69 billion, up 3.7 percent over the year-ago year period.

As of January 31, the company had 1,962 Wal-Mart stores, 344 Supercenters, 436 Sam's Clubs, six Argentina units, five Brazilian units, 136 Canadian Wal-Mart stores, two stores in China, two Indonesian Supercenters, 152 Mexican units, and 11 Puerto Rico units.
